ffmpeg_required:
The `{{module_name}}` module requires **FFmpeg** to function.

Please install it from the official website:

- [https://ffmpeg.org](https://ffmpeg.org)

If FFmpeg is already installed, open a new terminal, check that `ffmpeg -version` works, then restart HomeGenie from that terminal.

If you do not need this feature, you can disable this module

 in the **Automation Programs** section, or by clicking the button below.
